lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a semi-regular grid-like distribution with increasing spatial separation along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side and a distinct shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots, primarily concentrated along the lower half and leading edge of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. A dark vertical indentation or scar is located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit exhibits a dense clustering of micro-blobs with significantly higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter compared to the lateral flank patterning.
